abstract: Covers HTTP Extensions for Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV). RFC 4918 HTTP Extensions for Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV) is current; RFC 4791 Calendaring Extensions to WebDAV (CalDAV) is current; RFC 6352 CardDAV: vCard Extensions to Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV) is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
